relatedWorkVerification.basis: All author-year labels and titles were checked against the fixed-version manuscript literature review and reference list, pages 7–12 and 45–49. No new external references were introduced.
relatedWorkVerification.linkPolicy: One PDF literature-review link; no invented arXiv HTML section fragments.

boundariesPreserved: Task-specific positioning, not functional nail firing, hammer impact, pushing-force performance, or installation quality.
Controlled laboratory motion reproduction, not autonomous field roofing deployment.
Unquantified hoist loads, interventions and assisted recoveries; no assertion of unassisted operation.
New edited video excerpts illustrate motions separately from published quantitative measurements; no unverified assignment of an excerpt to a measured trial.
Discrete, training-dependent slope coverage; no continuous or zero-shot generalization claim.
External pure-RL and SONIC comparisons are diagnostic, not pooled matched ablations.
Existing four limitation statements reused verbatim.
